none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

results.references: - Florian Hübler, Ilyas Fatkhullin, Niao He. [From Gradient Clipping to Normalization for Heavy Tailed SGD](https://opt-ml.org/papers/2024/paper58.pdf). 2024 (OPT workshop; AISTATS publication 2025). Complexity: $O\!\left(1+\frac{\Delta L}{\varepsilon^2}\left[1+\left(\frac{6\sigma}{\varepsilon}\right)^{\alpha/(\alpha-1)}\right]\right)$ stochastic-gradient oracle calls, with fixed cost including initialization, for normalized SGD with momentum and a uniformly selected iterate satisfying $\mathbb E\|\nabla f(x)\|_2\le\varepsilon$.

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained differentiable objectives on R^d, permitting nonconvexity, with globally L-Lipschitz gradient and f(x0)-inf_x f(x) ≤ Δ. No minimizer attainment or convexity is required. L>0 and Δ≥0.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Each call at x returns g(x,ξ) using a fresh IID seed. The jointly measurable, integrable oracle is unbiased: E[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x). Neither function values nor paired evaluations using the same sample are provided.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedAdam.lean: spec.admissible, oracle answer and unbiasedness clauses; supplied LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID.

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: For every x, E[Σ_i |g_i(x,ξ)-∇_i f(x)|^α]≤σ^α, with 1<α≤2 and σ≥0. This bounds the summed coordinate central moments, implies E||g(x,ξ)-∇f(x)||_2^α≤σ^α without a dimension factor, and permits infinite variance when α<2. Independence between coordinates is not required.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedAdam.lean: spec.valid and the final two clauses of spec.admissible.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is R^d with its Euclidean norm, for public d∈ℕ.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedAdam.lean: Params.d and Params.x0; supplied LongTails/Algorithms/Adam.lean: Point.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: All parameters, including L, σ, α, Δ, ε and x0, are public. The objective and oracle distribution are hidden. Calls use IID seeds, and the extracted budget is a fixed cap counting individual oracle replies. The allowedAlgorithm field restricts admissible methods to the supplied Adam.method family; the literature comparison concerns the attainable rate, not implementation identity.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedAdam.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.admissible and spec.allowedAlgorithm; LongTails/Template.lean: execute and Convergence.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: The output must be measurable, its Euclidean gradient norm integrable, and E||∇f(output)||_2≤ε for ε>0. The criterion uses the first power of the norm, not its square.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Expectation is over both algorithm randomization and oracle seeds. No high-probability or almost-sure accuracy guarantee is required.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedAdam.lean: spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence, product probability law.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: An established smooth nonconvex stochastic-optimization benchmark with unbiased IID gradients, bounded central heavy-tail moments, and expected first-order stationarity. The coordinate moment bound is a conventional finite-dimensional noise condition.
